population: All 18 already registered UEFA Champions League fixtures in the same Beijing window. Reuse identical verified public HKJC 90-minute event and actual market line from the first direct-score issue.
algorithm: Derive independent W/D/L and total predictions from the whole correct-score book: proportional de-vig over every named score and every mutually exclusive official other bucket; attribute all group mass to its known WDL. For a total line assign a grouped settlement only if all score totals allowed by that group have the same Asian settlement. Otherwise abstain from that direction. Compare against the original independent HDA + actual-total matrix on the same line, using strict win/nonpush then settlement balance. No weight tuning.
hypothesis: Direct correct-score prices add information about directions beyond the 1X2 and main total. Save per-fixture probabilities, overround, input clocks, main total line, disagreements and missing rows before kickoff.
